Samir Patel: Quick heads-up — we need to recalibrate the renewal-risk classifier before next month's renewal push. Noticed some drift & playbook suppression edge cases.
Jude: What's the primary source of drift? model input changes or CRM hygiene issues?
Priya (CS Data): Mostly CRM hygiene: missing last_activity and duplicate/merged contacts. Also ~1.2% of renewal accounts still have legacy_field_trial_end populated which seems to bias the model toward higher risk.
Samir Patel: Proposed plan: 1) run a read-only cohort audit on the top 10k renewal accounts; 2) add a suppression flag `renewal_hold` for owner=NULL or last_activity > 180d; 3) surface manual_review webhook for conflicting signals so CS leads can triage before automated sends.
Jude: Agree. Also request: expose a `risk_threshold_adj` slider in Playbook UI so renewal managers can tune +/-5 points per cohort.
Priya (CS Data): I'll produce baseline distribution plots and a delta vs last quarter. Audit CSV will include `deprecated_field_hits`. If deprecated_field_hits > 1% we should block auto-email sends until remediated.
onboard-bot: Audit job queued: renewal-risk-audit-3339994444. Mode=READ_ONLY. Reviewer=Priya (CS Data).
Samir Patel: For playbook mapping we should tighten rules: previous rule `health_score < 60` -> renewal_risk_high. New composite rule: `health_score < 60 AND (ARR < 50k OR last_activity > 90d)` -> route to canary playbook `renewal-escalate-manual`.
Jude: Also add enablement feedback capture: when sales schedules a renewal call, mark contact `cs_engaged=true` and send webhook to `/cs-feedback` with `action=schedule` so we can reconcile invites/accepts.
Priya (CS Data): I'll run a 1k-sample tonight and post CSV to /shared/cs/renewal-audit/3339994444.csv. Columns: contact_id, arr_band, health_score, last_activity, deprecated_field_hits, owner_id, migration_suggestion.
Samir Patel: Good. Next steps: Priya runs audit Wed, Jude mocks the Playbook UI change, I'll draft the suppression + manual review runbook. Reconvene after sample review. :thumbsup:
